title: Al Haramain Amber Oud: every edition compared, from Gold to Tobacco
body:
Al Haramain's Amber Oud is a family of eau de parfums rather than a single scent. Each edition has its own colour and its own character, from the sweet, fruity Gold to the spiced Tobacco and the fresh, herbal Carbon. Here is every Al Haramain Amber Oud edition we stock, side by side, with its notes, sizes and the kind of person it suits.

Is there oud in Amber Oud?

Amber Oud is the name of the line. The note lists we hold for these editions do not name oud: they are built on amber, woods, musk, vanilla and resins, with fruit, flowers, spice or herbs on top depending on the edition. If you want a perfume that puts oud at the centre, read our oud perfume guide. If you want a warm, amber-led scent with an Arabian feel, read on.

Sweet and fruity: the original and the Gold Edition

Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (from £32.99, 60ml, 100ml or 200ml) opens with bergamot and green notes, moves into melon, pineapple, amber and sweet notes, and dries down to vanilla, musk and woods. It is the edition to choose if you like sweet, golden, fruity scents.

The original Al Haramain Amber Oud (£38.99, 60ml) carries the same note list in our listings: bergamot and green notes, then amber, melon, pineapple and sweet notes, then vanilla, musk and woods. The brand sells them as separate editions, so expect them to be close relatives.

For a stronger version, Amber Oud Extreme Gold Edition (from £36.99, 60ml or 100ml) is an extrait de parfum with the same listed notes. An extrait has a higher concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de parfum; our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.

Warm and spiced: Ruby, Tobacco and Black

  • Amber Oud Ruby Edition (from £41.99, 100ml, 120ml or 200ml): saffron and bitter almond, then jasmine and cedarwood, over ambergris, woods and musk. Spiced, nutty and floral, a smooth choice for evenings.
  • Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (£32.99, 60ml): tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, then vanilla, clove, star anise, cacao and tonka bean, over tobacco, dried fruits and woods. The richest and sweetest of the spiced editions, made for winter nights.
  • Amber Oud Black Edition (£39.99, 100ml): cardamom, grapefruit and lavender, then leather, amber and orange blossom, over benzoin, ambergris and vetiver. Darker and drier, with a leather heart.

Fresh and woody: Bleu and Carbon

  • Amber Oud Bleu Edition (from £38.99, 60ml, 100ml or 200ml): grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper, then ginger, nutmeg and jasmine, over incense, vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, patchouli, labdanum and white musk. Crisp at the start and woody underneath, easy to wear all year.
  • Amber Oud Carbon Edition (from £35.99, 60ml, 100ml or 200ml): lavender, rosemary and bergamot, then sage, cedarwood and geranium, over vetiver, musk, amber and moss. A clean, herbal scent sold as a men's fragrance, good for the office.

Floral: the White Edition

Amber Oud White Edition (from £34.99, 60ml, 100ml or 200ml) is sold as a women's fragrance: bergamot and orange, then jasmine, rose and freesia, over musk, vanilla and patchouli. It is the lightest and most floral of the family, an easy pick for daytime.

Which Amber Oud edition should you choose?

  • You like sweet, fruity scents: Gold Edition, or Extreme Gold for a richer version.
  • You want something warm for winter: Tobacco Edition or Ruby Edition.
  • You like leather and dry woods: Black Edition.
  • You want a fresh everyday scent: Bleu Edition, or Carbon for a herbal, barbershop style.
  • You prefer florals: White Edition.

Most editions are unisex; Carbon is sold for men and White for women, but wear whichever you like. Prefer amber without the fruit? The sister scent Al Haramain Amber Musk (£39.99, 100ml) is amber and floral notes over musk, woods, vanilla and resins.

How to wear it

These are full, warm eau de parfums, so start with a spray or two on the neck and wrists rather than a cloud. They sit well on moisturised skin; our guide to layering oud with body butter shows how. For the wider family of Arabian scents, see our Arabian perfume guide.

Good to know

  • Sizes vary by edition: Gold, Bleu, Carbon and White come in 60ml, 100ml and 200ml; check each listing for the size you want.
  • As a gift: the warmer editions make a generous Christmas present. See our perfume gift sets guide for more ideas.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Al Haramain fragrance, browse Arabian perfume and oud perfume, or see our amber fragrances.
